title: A Student's Daily Routine
lines: My name is Daniel, and I'm a student.
Today, I'm going to tell you about my daily routine.
On weekdays, I usually wake up at seven o'clock.
I don't like getting up early, especially when the weather is cold, but I have to get ready for school.
First, I wash my face and brush my teeth.
Then I get dressed and go to the kitchen.
My mother usually prepares breakfast for the family.
I normally have eggs, bread, and tea.
Sometimes I eat cereal with milk if I don't have much time.
I leave home at about half past seven.
My school is not very far away, so I usually walk there.
I like walking because I can get some fresh air before my lessons start.
If it rains, my father sometimes drives me to school.
I study different subjects, including English, mathematics, history, and science.
English is my favourite subject because I enjoy learning new words and speaking with my classmates.
Mathematics is a little more difficult for me, but I try to practise it every day.
We have a short break at ten thirty.
I usually talk to my friends or buy something small to eat.
Our lunch break is at twelve thirty.
I often bring a sandwich and some fruit from home, but sometimes I eat lunch in the school cafeteria.
When I get home, I have lunch if I'm hungry and then take a short rest.
After that, I do my homework.
I usually spend about one hour on it, but some days I need more time.
In the evening, I like listening to music, watching videos, or playing computer games.
I also help my parents with small jobs around the house.
For example, I sometimes wash the dishes or tidy my room.
We usually have dinner together at seven thirty.
After dinner, I prepare my school bag and choose my clothes for the next day.
I don't want to do these things in the morning because I'm often in a hurry.
Before going to bed, I sometimes read a few pages of a book.
I usually go to bed at ten thirty.
I know that getting enough sleep is important, so I try not to stay up late.
My weekends are quite different because I don't have to go to school.

What do you usually do together as a family?
At weekends, we sometimes watch a film or visit my grandparents.
My father also enjoys cooking, so he prepares special meals on Sundays.
What did you do at your family lunch yesterday?
My grandmother made her famous chicken soup, and my father prepared a big dish of plov.
We also had a salad and some fruit.
After lunch, we sat in the garden and talked.
I don't see my grandparents very often because they live far away.
You should call them more often.
My grandmother really enjoys talking on the phone.
She always asks me about school and my friends.
Family is important, even when everyone is busy.

title: Food Around the World
lines: Today, we're going to talk about food around the world.
Food is an important part of every culture.
People in different countries eat different meals, use different ingredients, and have their own cooking traditions.
Italian food is famous in many countries.
Pizza and pasta are two of the most popular dishes.
Italian people often use tomatoes, cheese, olive oil, and fresh vegetables.
Many families enjoy eating together, especially at weekends.
A traditional Italian meal can take quite a long time because people like talking while they eat.
Rice is an important part of Japanese food.
Many people eat rice with fish, vegetables, and soup.
Sushi is one of the most famous Japanese dishes.
It usually contains rice and fish, although there are different types.
Japanese meals are often simple and carefully prepared.
In Mexico, food is usually full of flavour.
People put meat, vegetables, cheese, or beans inside small tortillas.
Some Mexican dishes are spicy because cooks use different kinds of peppers.
However, not every Mexican meal is hot.
There are also many sweet dishes and desserts.
Indian food is known for its spices.
People use ingredients such as rice, potatoes, tomatoes, and different spices.
Curry is a popular dish, and there are many different versions.
Some people eat meat, while others prefer vegetarian meals.
In fact, vegetarian food is very common in many parts of India.
Uzbek cuisine has a long history and many traditional dishes.
Plov is probably the most famous one.
It is usually made with rice, meat, carrots, onions, and oil.
People often prepare it for family celebrations and special events.
Other popular dishes include somsa, manti, and shashlik.
Although food is different around the world, it brings people together.
Families share meals, friends meet at restaurants, and people celebrate important moments with special dishes.
So, next time you try food from another country, remember that you are also learning something about its culture.

title: Healthy Habits and Daily Life
lines: Hello, and welcome to Everyday Choices, a podcast about simple habits that can make daily life better.
R. A. C. H. E. L.
Today we're talking about healthy habits.
Some people think a healthy lifestyle requires expensive food, special equipment or lots of free time.
However, many useful habits are simple.
Having a regular sleeping routine can help you feel more organised.
If you wake up at seven, you might choose to go to bed at around ten thirty or eleven.
People need different amounts of sleep, but enough rest is important.
The second habit is drinking water.
Some people forget to drink during busy days.

Another habit is eating a variety of foods.
Fruit, vegetables, grains and other foods can all be part of balanced meals.
You don't need to eat the same thing every day.
You could have eggs and bread for breakfast, rice with vegetables for lunch, and soup for dinner.
You don't have to join a sports club.

title: Weather and Life Around the World
lines: Today we're visiting four cities to find out how weather affects daily life.
Our first report comes from Oslo, the capital of Norway.
H. A. N. S. E. N.
The temperature is minus three degrees Celsius, and there is light snow.
Many people are wearing warm coats, hats and gloves.
The roads are slippery, so drivers are moving slowly.
Some children have outdoor winter activities at school.
Now let's travel to Nairobi in Kenya.
M. W. A. N. G. I.
Many people enjoy spending time outside.
The rainy season is expected to begin next month, so people are preparing their gardens and checking their roofs.
Our next stop is Tokyo, Japan.
There is a light wind, but no rain.
The stations are busy because many people travel by train.
In spring, Tokyo is famous for its cherry blossoms.
Visitors go to parks to see the flowers and take photographs.
Finally, let's visit Sydney in Australia.
S. Y. D. N. E. Y.
C. O. L. L. I. N. S.
Many people are going to the beach, swimming or having lunch outside.
In summer, it can become very hot.
People should drink water, use sun protection and look for shade during the hottest part of the day.
Thank you to all our reporters.
Weather can be very different around the world.
In one city, people may wear winter coats, while in another, they enjoy a sunny day at the beach.
Weather affects transport, school activities, work and travel plans.
Before leaving home, it's useful to check the forecast and choose suitable clothes.
Take an umbrella if rain is expected.
Wear warm clothes in cold weather.
On very hot days, drink enough water and avoid staying in the sun for too long.
Oslo will be minus one degree.
Tokyo will be nineteen degrees, and Sydney will be thirty degrees.
That's all for World Weather Today.
